game.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 Campaign Remastered
game.blurb: Military first-person shooter, a remaster of the 2009 Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 single-player campaign, from Infinity Ward and Beenox (as RAWG lists them), released 2020-03-31. RAWG has no playtime yet. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapter order follows the StrategyWiki walkthrough of the 2009 original (CC BY-SA 4.0), grouped by mission.

chapters.title: The Opening Missions
chapters.summary: S.S.D.D., Team Player and Cliffhanger: the first three missions.

chapters.title: Missions 6 to 8
chapters.summary: Wolverines!, The Hornet's Nest and Exodus.

chapters.title: Missions 9 to 11
chapters.summary: The Only Easy Day... Was Yesterday, The Gulag and Of Their Own Accord.

chapters.title: Missions 12 to 14
chapters.summary: Contingency, Second Sun and Whiskey Hotel. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: The Final Missions
chapters.summary: Loose Ends, The Enemy of My Enemy, Just Like Old Times and Endgame, plus the bonus Museum level. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Enemy Intelligence
chapters.summary: The Enemy Intelligence collectibles that StrategyWiki tracks across the missions.

Wiki structure from StrategyWiki under CC BY-SA 4.0 (chapter order from its walkthrough contents; titles reworded, no text copied) — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Call_of_Duty:_Modern_Warfare_2
Fandom (callofduty.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://callofduty.fandom.com/wiki/Call_of_Duty:_Modern_Warfare_2_Campaign_Remastered
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Route cc-by-sa: StrategyWiki has no page under "Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 Campaign Remastered" or "Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 Remastered", so its guide for the 2009 original, "Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2", is used (completion stage 2, 76 existing subpages, about 282,000 characters). Its contents list 19 campaign missions from "S.S.D.D." to "Museum"; 13 are written (about 1,100 to 7,100 characters each), while "No Russian", "Whiskey Hotel", "Loose Ends", "The Enemy of My Enemy", "Just Like Old Times" and "Endgame" are linked but not created. Chapters group the missions in contents order; titles are reworded and no text was copied. RAWG describes the remaster as the single-player campaign of the 2009 game and names Cliffhanger, The Gulag and Whiskey Hotel, which match StrategyWiki page names; whether the remaster's mission list matches exactly was not checked. The guide's Special Ops and Multiplayer sections were left out, because RAWG describes only the campaign. callofduty.fandom.com answers the API under "Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 Campaign Remastered", with about 198 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. No Steam app, so steam is none. RAWG has no playtime for this entry.
